About the Role
DoorDash is building the world's most reliable on-demand, logistics engine for delivery. We are continuing to grow rapidly and expanding our Engineering offices globally! We are looking for Software Engineers, Machine Learning to build and maintain a large scale 24x7 global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's 3-sided marketplace of Consumers, Merchants and Dashers.
As a Software Engineer, Machine Learning, you’ll be conceptualizing, designing, implementing, and validating algorithmic improvements to the catalog system and our product knowledge graph at the heart of our fast-growing grocery and retail delivery business. You will use our robust data and machine learning infrastructure to implement new ML solutions to make our product knowledge graph accurate, standardized, semantically rich, easily discoverable, and extensible. We’re looking for someone with a command of production-level machine learning and experience with solving end-user problems who enjoys collaborating with multi-disciplinary teams.
This role is hybrid with some in-office time expected and will report to an Engineering Manager.
You're excited about this opportunity because you will...
Develop advanced machine learning models to improve ads efficiency and quality.
Design and build optimization algorithms for budget pacing and automated bidding to achieve various advertising goals.
Establish a data-driven framework to understand how the bid density and market competitiveness would affect advertising value and platform revenue.
Develop new data solutions (eg. embeddings and consumer profiles) to target the relevant audience.
Be responsible for the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including ideation, offline model training, online shadowing/deployment, experimentation, and post-launch monitoring/measurement.
Build and extend the current data/ML infrastructure to empower Ads data applications including data analysis, ML modeling, and experimentation.
Scale our systems and services to fuel the growth of our business.

M.S., or PhD. in a technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics or equivalent.
3+ years ML industry experience with a solid understanding of machine learning algorithms and fundamentals.
Experience building data/feature engineering pipelines at scale using Pyspark and Snowflake SQL.
Experience with building machine learning systems in production by using frameworks such as PyTorch, Keras, lightgbm, scikit-learn, Spark ML, or related.

Online advertising
Search relevance & ranking

jobs.description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Role Purpose The OEM Computer Specialist is the technical visionary responsible for the "compute backbone" of Thermo Fisher’s instrumentation portfolio. This role bridges the gap between scientific instrument design and the rapid release cycles of Tier-1 hardware (Dell, HP), silicon (NVIDIA, Intel), and software (Microsoft) partners. Key Responsibilities 1. Enterprise Harmonization & Governance Multi-Divisional Standards: Drive the harmonization of computer and OS architectures across disparate Thermo Fisher divisions (Analytical Instruments, Life Sciences, Specialty Diagnostics) to leverage enterprise-scale buying power and simplify global support. Strategic Interface Management: Negotiate requirements between Thermo Fisher’s specialized scientific groups , Tier-1 hardware vendors (Dell/HP), and external integrators to ensure a consistent, branded, and high-performance product. Lifecycle Convergence: Harmonize mismatched product lifecycles across the enterprise by coordinating "Last Time Buy" programs and multi-year supply strategies for shared hardware components. Compliance Unification: Consolidate to a single quality management framework for computer systems validation (CSV), reducing redundant documentation efforts across divisions while maintaining rigorous FDA 21 CFR Part 11 standards. Design Synchronization: Help create a unified framework for "Golden Images" and hardware builds that allows different instrument groups to share core components while maintaining the ability to specialize where scientifically necessary. 2. Strategic Lifecycle & Roadmap Management Multi-Tier Lifecycle Alignment: Synchronize the 10-year lifecycle of scientific instruments with the 18–36 month refresh cycles of Tier-1 vendors. Secure "Extended Lifecycle" (XE/XL) hardware to prevent premature obsolescence. Supplier Diplomacy: Act as the primary technical interface for Dell OEM Solutions, NVIDIA, and Microsoft, influencing their future roadmaps to meet the specific power, thermal, and stability needs of lab environments 3. Regulatory Compliance & Validation Define Validated Base Images: Architect and maintain "Locked Configurations" for OS and hardware (e.g., Windows 10/11 IoT Enterprise LTSC) to ensure a stable, reproducible environment required for Installation (IQ) and Operational Qualification (OQ) , FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP compliance. Serviceable Security: Negotiate cybersecurity requirements to protect instruments from network threats while ensuring the OS is not so "locked down" that Field Service Engineers (FSEs) cannot perform diagnostics or local repairs. Quality Risk Management: Conduct Validation Risk Assessments (RA) for any proposed computer hardware changes, ensuring that technology refreshes do not compromise the instrument’s validated state. 4. Integrator & Operations Management Integrator Governance: Direct third-party Computer Integrators (e.g., Unicom, Avnet, MBX) on custom hardware builds, including custom BIOS settings, branding/labeling, and specialized shock-resistant packaging. Integrator Management: Act as the primary technical point of contact for external Computer Integrators. Oversee the conversion of standard Tier-1 (Dell/HP) hardware into "Thermo Fisher Branded" appliances through custom imaging, BIOS configuration, and hardware hardening. Custom Hardware Engineering: Specify and validate mechanical customizations, including custom labeling (branding/regulatory silk-screening), specialized packaging (shock-vibration protection), and unique physical security features (port blockers, custom cabling). OS & Image Governance: Manage the delivery and maintenance of golden images (Windows LTSC/Linux) to the integrator. Ensure the deployment of "Locked" OS environments that disable non-essential services to guarantee instrument stability and security. Supply Chain Continuity: Manage "Long-Term Stocking" programs and "Last-Time-Buy" (LTB) events with the integrator to bridge gaps between Dell/NVIDIA hardware EOL dates and the end-of-support dates for Thermo Fisher instruments. Required Qualifications Education: B.S. or greater in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Experience: 3+ years in systems architecture, specifically within an OEM integration or industrial computing context Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of computer hardware fundamentals (CPU, RAM, data logic).Strong knowledge of Dell/HP OEM portfolios and NVIDIA GPU architectures . Expertise in Windows IoT Enterprise LTSC and Linux hardening. Soft Skills: Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Enterprise Architecture: Strong understanding of Enterprise Architecture (EA) governance principles and their application in industrial/scientific environments. Technical Soft Skills: Demonstrated ability to negotiate technical requirements across competing internal departments (Quality, Cybersecurity, Engineering, and Field Service). Cybersecurity Knowledge: Familiarity with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools and their impact on high-performance computing environments. Manufacturing Instruction & SOPs: Develop the detailed "Build-to-Order" (BTO) documentation for the integrator, defining everything from drive partitioning to the exact torque specs for custom mounting brackets. Quality Audit Participation: Participate in technical audits of the integrator’s facilities to ensure their production lines meet the quality standards required for medical device and life science instrumentation. Preferred Qualifications Service Background: (Preferred) Prior experience in field service or technical support to provide "empathy-driven design" for the serviceability of the system. Leadership Presence: Proven ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders in a highly matrixed global organization. Conflict Resolution: Act as the final arbiter when "Security Requirements" conflict with "Instrument Performance" (e.g., anti-virus scans interrupting high-speed data acquisition from a mass spec).

jobs.description: NO CYBERSECURITY, READ DESCRIPTION Amazon's data centers house the infrastructure that powers the world's largest cloud. Protecting them is mission-critical — and as a Security Specialist Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will help ensure the physical security of these facilities from the inside. You will drive operational security excellence, write reports, create presentations, and communicate with management on the status of physical security operations. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us. This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Security Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs. Who Should Apply We welcome applications from: - Students in the last year of their Technical/Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Security Management, Criminology, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career. About the Role As a Security Specialist Intern, you will work within the Data Center Security team and play a hands-on role in the day-to-day physical security operations of Amazon's data centers. You will collaborate with security vendors, analyze operational data, and help identify improvements to surveillance systems, access controls, and security procedures. This is not a desk-only role. You will engage directly with the people, systems, and processes that keep Amazon's most critical infrastructure safe. What You Will Do - Coordinate with vendors involved in new security construction, repairs, daily security operations and patrols, and planning. - Analyze security metrics and data to identify trends and recommend improvements - Make suggestions on improving electronic surveillance systems and access controls - Help develop and deliver guidance to data center occupants on reducing false alarms - Write reports and create presentations on the status of physical security operations for management - Assist with planning and coordinating security-related projects - Support incident documentation and follow-up processes Internship Structure Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying. Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go. From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help protect the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale. Impact. Your work protects the physical infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. The security operations you support keep Amazon's most critical facilities safe and running. Action. You will move fast, analyze real security data, and make recommendations that get implemented. Your ideas do not stay theoretical — they get tested and put into practice. Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will learn how physical security operates at world-class scale and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon. Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape. About the team AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

jobs.description: Job Description The Role: Are you a highly creative design individual who is interested in being part of one of the most exciting design studios in the world? Based in Warren, Michigan, where the fusion of Art, Design and Technology come together, General Motors North America has exciting opportunities for creative designers in many areas of the organization across our Advanced and Production studios including interiors, exteriors, components, accessories, lighting and product. As a Senior Creative Designer at GM, you will be part of a larger, connected, global design team working on forward-thinking, extraordinary elements in production design. We are looking for someone who thrives in a team environment and displays a strong ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines. We need someone with a considerable amount of perception, design taste, judgment and creativity as well as a high level of skill, accuracy, and coordination. Your role will be to see the future - researching, designing and creating proposals that demonstrate innovative concepts, from inception to implementation, for automotive and mobility applications. You will create fresh, innovative designs with customer experience in mind for interiors for GM brands. Through the lens of brand strategy, you will generate concepts in both 2D and 3D proposals. You will adeptly refine ideas as you receive feedback. You will coordinate the work of other design personnel and collaborate with multiple partners to achieve design goals. You will follow design process from the sketch form to the final release clay model. If you are driven and eager to propel your career forward, take your next step in joining a world class design studio at General Motors! What You'll Do: Lead a design team to develop bold interior designs that support brand goals and enhance customer experience. The role requires strong design judgment, creativity, and attention to detail. Translate ideas into finished designs using 2D sketches, animations [Ai], 3D sketch tools, and close collaboration with clay and digital sculpting teams. Collaborate frequently with the design team, sculpting organization, engineering and fabrication teams in the development of new designs. Provide insight and recommendations to leadership while possessing willingness and acuity to act upon guidance in a deadline driven environment. Maintain knowledge of current design trends and technology. Present ideas frequently to management and leadership to communicate design ideas. Exhibit courage and challenge expectations. Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications): Minimum 5 years of experience in an OEM design studio. Bachelor’s Degree in Design (Automotive, Transportation, Industrial…). Strong understanding of form, 2-D to 3-D interpretation, and ability to visualize. Creativity, independence, Autonomy, Problem solving, design judgment, team spirit, volume understanding. Ability to work independently and lead a team as well as provide mentoring. For your portfolio; several series of sketches and ideations, production program experience samples. Director and Head of CRM Analytics and Science

category growth, onsite marketing optimization, outbound channel optimization, and customer lifecycle management

and technical roadmap for CRM, lifecycle marketing, and channel optimization data science initiatives.
Build, mentor, and scale

to embed data science deeply into our marketing automation and customer engagement platforms.

to ensure the scalability and reliability of real-time data pipelines required for marketing personalization.
Technical Excellence
Set the gold standard for experimentation
, measurement, and causal inference within the onsite marketing, CRM and lifecycle measurement domains.
Ensure the scalability, robustness, and monitoring
of production models handling massive scale and real-time decisioning.
Stay ahead of emerging trends
in AI, deep learning, NLP, and recommendation systems to continuously improve our marketing tech stack.
Basic Qualifications
Undergraduate degree or higher in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research, or a related discipline
8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or advanced analytics.
5+ years of experience directly leading and managing high-performing data science teams.
Proven track record of delivering measurable business impact (e.g., lift in conversion, retention, ROI) through production-grade machine learning models.
Strong foundation in statistical modeling, machine learning, personalization/recommendation systems, and large-scale A/B testing.

Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research, or a related discipline.

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to sit at the heart of one of our New Games teams and help turn early concepts into games players want to discover, try and keep playing. This is not a traditional, campaign-led marketing role. You will be an embedded, hands-on growth partner from the earliest stages of development - working alongside Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics and Creative to make smarter bets, test them quickly and learn faster. You will bring a growth-hacker mindset: spot an opportunity, form a sharp hypothesis, build the test, read the signals and decide what happens next. Some experiments will not work. That is part of the job. What matters is the quality and speed of the learning, and how you turn it into a better game and a stronger route to market. This is a high-autonomy individual-contributor role for someone who enjoys doing, not delegating. You will be broad across marketing, comfortable picking up work wherever it is needed, and excited to use AI tools to increase the pace and quality of your output. One week you might shape a player proposition, the next launch a creative test, interrogate funnel data or streamline how the team learns from experiments. If you want to help build a game from concept - and get meaningful marketing tests into market within weeks - this could be your next move. Your role within the Kingdom As Growth Marketing Manager, New Games, you will: Embed in a cross-functional game team and influence product, player and growth decisions from concept through launch. Identify the biggest growth questions early, turn them into focused hypotheses and run rapid tests to answer them. Design and execute marketing experiments across propositions, audiences, channels, creative, store presence and early-player journeys. Bring performance marketing thinking into product development, connecting acquisition, conversion, retention and player value to product choices. Use player research, market signals, competitor analysis and data to uncover opportunities - and make clear recommendations. Partner closely with Product, Analytics, Creative, Development and central King teams to align on priorities, unlock expertise and move work forward. Build practical test-and-learn processes that make the team faster, clearer and more effective over time. Roll up your sleeves across the marketing mix: briefing creative developing positioning, analysing results, writing test plans and communicating the story behind the data. Use AI tools thoughtfully and responsibly to accelerate research, ideation, analysis, production and operational work. Communicate decisions and learning clearly to a wide range of stakeholders, creating alignment without slowing momentum. What you will bring Experience and mindset Experience in growth, performance, product, brand or consumer marketing within games, entertainment, apps or another digital consumer business. A demonstrable bias for action: you can take an ambiguous problem, create a plan and deliver a useful first version quickly. A test-and-learn mentality. You are comfortable taking smart risks, learning from setbacks and changing course when the evidence says to. Strong commercial and analytical instincts, with the ability to turn data into practical next steps. Comfort working in a fast-moving, start-up-like environment where priorities evolve and there is no large support team behind every task. Confidence collaborating across disciplines and influencing stakeholders with different perspectives. Hands-on experience with AI tools, or strong curiosity and evidence that you actively use them to improve how you work. Challenges assumptions constructively and brings others with you. Sees process improvement as a growth lever, not an administrative exercise. Gets energy from close, on-site collaboration with a game team. Why New Games at King? You will have the freedom and proximity of a small, ambitious game team, paired with the reach, craft and player understanding of King. Your work will shape real product decisions early when insight, creativity and a great experiment can have an outsized impact.
